name: Community Water Development Fund

funder.name: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage (Ireland)

summary: Annual grants for Irish community and voluntary groups and environmental NGOs to improve water quality through river and wetland restoration, nature-based solutions and habitat works. The 2026 round closed in January 2026.

amount.note: Higher grant rates may be considered in certain circumstances

steps: Contact your local Community Water Officer

eligibility.rule: No excluded activities or costs, e.g. staff, overheads, insurance, income-generating or other RBMS-funded work
Any CWDF 2026 grant was fully paid before 5 December 2026
Submits no more than one application per organisation
Project takes direct water quality action and fits at least one eligible category
Strategic Project Provision projects span no more than 3 years or phases
Multiyear projects demonstrate a long-term water quality or ecological impact across a wider catchment

documents: Constitution of the organisation or minutes of the most recent meeting
Most recent bank statement of the organisation
Quotations for each cost item, inclusive of VAT
Most recent audited or accountant-verified accounts or financial statement
Drawings, plans, specifications or photographs, if applicable
Applicable project permissions, including planning conditions or exemption, statutory and landowner consents
Current insurance policy, if physical work or voluntary labour is proposed
Tax reference number and clearance if the request or annual RBMS awards exceed €10,000
Support letters from other parties whose involvement is needed

amount.quote: the minimum individual grant amount awarded under this scheme will be €5,000 up to a maximum of €40,000

co_finance_required.quote: It is not a grant condition, but it is recommended that applicants can demonstrate their ability to make a cash contribution

consortium_required.quote: Sole applicant organisations based in the Republic of Ireland only

effort.quote: Applicants MUST contact and liaise with their local Community Water Officer (CWO) before submitting their application form.
Closing Date Deadlines Applications via Online Portal www.riverbasin.ie 13 Monday, 18 January 2027 at h 11:30pm

eligibility.quote: Projects that solely benefit an individual. Teaching/staffing in schools. Travel, phone and transport costs except in exceptional circumstances. Equipment, unless directly associated with the project. Income generating projects. Overheads, ongoing running costs. Insurance. Accommodation and subsistence. Staff costs. Projects or expenditure funded under other RBMS fundingschemes.
To be eligible to apply, grants awarded under the CWDF 2026 scheme must be fully paid before 5th December 2026.
Only one application may be submitted per eligible organisation.
Projects must demonstrate direct water quality actions and must fall into at least one of the categories listed below:
The phased approach must not exceed 3 years/phases (e.g., 2027–2029).
If your project has potential to span more than one funding year, you must demonstrate a long-term water quality or ecological impact across a wider river catchment.

after_award.quote: Applicants must submit a project summary report with the completed final drawdown form and include pictures, video clips, media articles, etc., as appropriate.
Phased payments are strongly encouraged and will be considered on a case-by-case basis on completion of a partial drawdown request form. Progress reports will be required for each phase.

Any permissions required (e.g. Planning permission, Appropriate Assessments, Strategic Environment Assessments landowner consent, lease arrangements) must be submitted with the application form.

All organisations seeking grant aid in excess of €10,000 or where grants either paid or committed from RBMS during a financial year exceed €10,000 will be required to provide a Tax Reference Number (TRN) and evidence of Tax Clearance (or a Tax Clearance Access Number).

Where the involvement or help of another party is required for the success of your project, please include letter(s) of support outlining their agreement to participate and the extent of their involvement.
